hypothesis: Request246 improved entry timing but remained negative because the downstream HOLD/EXIT teacher is weak. A causal one-step position-value learner should decide whether waiting until the next observed state improves the executable sell value, then reconsider repeatedly without any best-future search.

target.name: hold_one_step_value
target.definition: percentage improvement in modeled executable sell value from exiting at the current observed state versus waiting to the immediately next observed state
target.execution_contract: first positive one-second aggregate open within 5 seconds after a 1-second latency

decision_rule: After the frozen Request246 entry, at each later state: if terminal, EXIT. If causal tradability probability is below 0.60, HOLD. Otherwise HOLD iff predicted one-step hold value > 0; else EXIT. Reconsider at the next observed state. Missing final policy exit falls to hot_t + 29 minute deadline.
forbidden: tuning the hold threshold on May11-20
using future one-second bars as features
opening June or any new holdout
claiming live brokerage fills from one-second aggregates
next_if_pass: Request248 should jointly retrain ENTER/WAIT with the improved position controller, then test the integrated sequential policy.
next_if_fail: Audit whether one-step continuation is too myopic or whether the causal state cannot distinguish favorable continuation from decay.
